findings.title: Registration can leave partial persistent state that its resume branch cannot complete
Indexed metadata loses YAML list and nested-object types
Namespace resolution discards the namespace identity
Optional evidence-pack file identity is not authenticated
Link navigation treats code examples as links and loses fragment targets
Publication refresh impact can omit references to replaced source identities
Future external-code publications inherit fixed edition-specific gap metadata
Unsupported singular publication edition remains in workbook metadata
Constraints heading navigation excludes rules on shared boundary pages
Four reference navigation pages omit metadata and lose scoped discovery tags
Media inventories retain pending classifications after source occurrences gained canonical mappings
Active-pointer format version is not checked
Two direct-debit figure labels are not literal source transcriptions

limitations: Corrections do not certify semantic accuracy of the complete corpus.
Existing source ambiguities, incomplete native-document reviews and needs-review statuses remain visible.
Refresh behavior was tested only in disposable fixtures; no live conversion/refresh was executed.
Execution verification is Windows only; portability elsewhere is static review.

publication_candidates.reason: Independent verification found that full-text search omitted metadata-only qualifications; reference payloads were intact.
